facts.text: The authors evaluated their models on 3 different datasets.
facts.source_quote: We evaluated our models on 3 different datasets:

facts.text: One evaluation dataset was the CSAT dataset, used for CSAT (customer satisfaction) prediction, consisting of spoken transcripts obtained automatically via ASR.
facts.source_quote: CSAT dataset for CSAT prediction, consisting of spoken transcripts (automatic via ASR).

facts.text: A second evaluation dataset was 20 newsgroups, used for a topic identification task, consisting of written text.
facts.source_quote: 20 newsgroups for topic identification task, consisting of written text;

facts.text: A third evaluation dataset was the Fisher Phase 1 corpus, used for a topic identification task, consisting of manually transcribed spoken conversations.
facts.source_quote: Fisher Phase 1 corpus for topic identification task, consisting of spoken transcripts (manual);
